jobs.prompt: Fix the Opus review 8 findings of the orchestrator-mode guard in tools/orchestrator-allow.mjs, tools/shell-writes.mjs and tools/handbuild.mjs and add tests to tests/orchestrator-allow.test.mjs (full guard, hand-build guard on and off). (1) HIGH npm flags placed BEFORE the verb run orchestrator-written code: 'npm --node-options=--require=./docs/plans/x.md test' (node runs a markdown file as JavaScript when required; the orchestrator may write that file), 'npm --userconfig=docs/plans/rc.md test', 'npm --prefix=docs/plans test', 'npm --workspace=x test' and (hand-build guard off) 'npm --script-shell=sh test' are all allowed today while the same flags after the verb are denied. Fix: for npm, pnpm and yarn allow ONLY the exact forms test, run SCRIPT, run-script SCRIPT (script names test, test:e2e, test:unit, e2e, lint is NOT included) with NO npm-level flags anywhere (before or after the verb) except a short list of harmless reporter flags (--silent, --if-present, and for test the argument separator is NOT allowed to carry runner flags except the vetted narrow list); always deny any flag whose name contains node-options, userconfig, globalconfig, prefix, workspace, workspaces, script-shell, cache, registry, config, loglevel with a path value, and -w, -C, -g; the same applies to pnpm (--filter, -C, --dir) and yarn (--cwd). Treat any file passed as a runner operand, --require, --import or --config argument as code regardless of its extension (an md, txt or json file in an orchestrator-writable folder is denied as a runner operand). (2) MED 'swarm ticket "x" --check <json>' (and swarm ship) lets the orchestrator choose a command that runs after the worker run integrates: deny --check on swarm ticket and ship, deny --test and --check forms that carry argv. (3) Usability: after an allowed 'cd docs/plans && git status' the session working folder stays in docs/plans and every swarm command is denied and nothing gets it back (cd ../.. works only inside a chain). Allow a standalone 'cd' to the project root (the resolved real path equals the project root), 'cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"' and 'cd -' when the previous folder was the root, and 'cd ../..' style relative cds whose resolved target is the project root; and make the deny message for a swarm command run from a non-root folder say exactly: run cd followed by the project root path first (print the real root path). (4) Follow-up list items worth doing now if small: deny 'swarm tickets --set approved'; keep --set cancelled and --acceptance allowed. Tests: each exploit form denied; every npm form from the earlier bug report still allowed (npm test, npm run test, npm run test:e2e with a package script, pnpm test, yarn test); the cd recovery forms allowed and then a swarm command from the root allowed; swarm ticket --check denied. Make every guard test pass: tests/orchestrator-allow.test.mjs, the orchestrator-mode, shell-writes, auto-approve and handbuild test files. STANDING TEST RULE: every test that spawns a process must set a per-test timeout of 60000 ms or less, pass a timeout to spawnSync, and kill children in its after hook. IMPORTANT: secret scanner: never write literal values for fields named token, secret, key or password in tests.
